title: Seiji Ebisu's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content:
The 157th issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G magazine launched the manga adaptation of Seiji Ebisu 's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken (The Case of Me Always Being the Topic of Discussion of the Student Council, Which Only Has Beautiful Girls as Members) novel, on Monday. Tarara is drawing the manga.

The story is set in Minamisawa Academy, where its student council president, Yurina Himesaki, is hailed as the best in the school's history. Led by Yurina, the deeply trusted student council's members are all beautiful girls, and on their agenda every day is romantic advice. With each member hiding herself as the person who is actually seeking romantic advice, Yurina and other student council members are unaware that they are all discussing and seeking advice about their crush Haruhisa Nanjō, a member of the school's Discipline Committee. Unaware of the situation, Haruhisa gets constantly tangled with the student council members' romantic advances.

Kadokawa published Ebisu's novel in April 2025 with illustration by Fuwari.

Ebisu launched the Ore ga Suki nano wa Imōto dakedo Imōto ja nai ( The One I Love is My Little Sister But She's Not a Little Sister ) light novel series with illustrator Gintarō in 2016. Kadokawa published the novels' 11th and final volume in 2020. Kō Narita drew the novels' manga adaptation, which was serialized in Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine from 2017 to 2019.

The novels also inspired a television anime adaptation in 2018 with the English title My Sister, My Writer .
author: ANN

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime's New Video Previews Ending Song
content:
The staff for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga started streaming a new promotional video on Thursday, which features the anime's ending theme song "Mata Ashita" (See You Tomorrow) by Shifuku Poncho .

The anime stars:

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Meguru Chojo

• Riko Aono as Nao Ippongi

• Maria Naganawa as Robo-kun

• Daisuke Ono as Yuki Inukai

• Toshiya Miyata as Hajime Keinain

• Nobuaki Kanemitsu as Hossan

• Kanna Nakamura as Lily Togari

• Kazuki Ura as Heisuke Ban

Junichi Yamamoto ( Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion ; Maebashi Witches ; Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You ) is directing the anime at Arvo Animation . Hayashi Mori ( Sand Land: The Series , Cells at Work! Code Black , Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse ) is superivsing and writing series scripts, and Masakatsu Sasaki ( 16bit Sensation: Another Layer , Seiyu's Life! , TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You ) is designing the characters. M!LK performs the opening theme song "That's! Chojo."

Viz Media and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service started publishing chapters of the manga simultaneously with the Japan release in February 2024. MANGA Plus describes the series:

The creator of Samon the Summoner returns to Jump with a new series about a super-powered policeman! In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Chojo! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary!

The manga was first published as a one-shot story in Weekly Shonen Jump in April 2023, and started serialization in February 2024. The manga ended in June 2025. Shueisha published the manga's final seventh and eighth compiled book volumes in September 2025. Viz Media will publish the manga's sixth volume physically on November 3.
author: ANN

title: Battle in 5 Seconds Manga Resumes
content:
Miyakokasiwa 's Battle in 5 Seconds ( Deatte 5-byō de Battle ) manga (a remake of Saizō Harawata 's original series) resumed on Thursday. Shogakukan had posted the previous chapter on June 11, and the author announced the hiatus on August 13.

The manga went on hiatus due to Miyakokasiwa struggling with poor health.

The manga previously went on hiatus in October 2024, and Miyakokasiwa had noted health and personal issues since the start of 2024. The author added at the time that the series was approaching its end. The manga resumed serialization in January 2025.

Comikey publishes the series in English and describes the story:

Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves challenging games and Konpeito candy. One day, while heading to school, he encounters an enigmatic woman called Mi on. After that, Akira and a host of other individuals are kidnapped and forced to become test pilots for a mysterious organization. They are given unique abilities and pitted against each other. Armed with his newfound, special ability, Akira becomes determined to take down this sinister group and beat their game. He has to rely on his guile to overcome all sorts of obstacles in a captivating battle of wits!

Harawata posted the original manga online before artist Miyakokasiwa launched a "remake" of the manga with new art in Shogakukan 's Ura Sunday web comic service in 2015. The manga is also on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app. Shogakukan published the manga's 31st compiled book volume on July 10.

The series inspired an anime adaptation in 2021. Crunchyroll released an English dub for the series.
author: ANN

title: OceanVeil Announces Simulcast Stream of My Girlfriend's Friend Anime
content:
OceanVeil announced on Thursday that it will simultaneously stream the anime of Jura 's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga, starting on October 4.

OceanVeil describes the anime's story:

Takeru Hidaka thought he had found simple happiness with his sweet, cheerful first girlfriend, Kaori. But his quiet high school life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Kaori's glamorous best friend, Tomoko. Striking, enigmatic, and possessing an effortless allure, Tomoko begins pulling Takeru into her orbit through subtle glances and unexpected closeness. Caught between his genuine feelings for Kaori and the irresistible magnetic pull surrounding Tomoko, Takeru finds his heart and resolve constantly tested. Can he maintain the line of devotion, or will secret desires redefine everything?

The anime will debut on Tokyo MX on October 4 at 25:05 (effectively October 5 at 1:05 a.m.), and will air on BS11 on October 7. The "Complete Deregula " version of the show will stream on AnimeFesta starting on October 5 at 1:05 a.m., and AnimeFesta and other services will also stream the on-air version of the show.

The anime will star:

• Ryūga Nagaike as Takeru

• Sayaka Hashi as Kaori

• Miki Hase as Tomoko

• Riho Sugiyama as Miyuki

• Ryōka Yuzuki as Kaori's mother

Takashi Andō is directing the anime at Quad . WWWave Corporation is credited as producer. Deregula is credited for production. Gokō Shiraki ( Hands off: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun ) is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Ryūji Iwata is designing the characters, and is also credited as chief animation director alongside Akira Koshiishi and Konatsu Kumagai . Hiroki Nishiyama is the sound director. Makoto Tōgō is the director of photography. Jun'ichi Masunaga is the editor. Naoto Awano is the animation producer. Naoki Onimaru is credited for setting production. Takafumi Suzuki is the producer, and Kazuki Yanase is the publicity producer.

Kazuma Akagi ( 9-nine- Ruler's Crown ) is the prop designer, Do Kim Hoan Tran ( Marika's Love Meter Malfunction ) is the art director, and Momoka Saeki is in charge of color design.

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime.

Airots performs the opening theme song "Gingira" and Ceui performs the ending theme song "False Love."

Jura debuted the manga in Kodansha 's YanMaga Web in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's seventh compiled book volume on July 16.

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Streams Teaser Video
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, started streaming the anime's teaser promotional video on Thursday.

The anime will star:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Netflix to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime
content:
Netflix announced on Thursday that it will stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series. The service will stream the anime in the United States on October 17. The anime is listed to start streaming on October 14 in selected areas/countries.

The first episode will also screen in advance at the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Special Panel at New York Comic Con on October 8.

The staff for the new anime includes:

• Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya

• Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro

• Editing: Eiichi Nishimura

• Compositing Director: Yōsuke Motoki

• Music: Norihito Sumitomo

The anime will again feature Kōichi Yamadera as Beerus.

MEGATERA･ZERO performs the opening theme song "ONOGAMI," and VK Blanka performs the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki."

Akio Iyoku stated the work started a few years ago and is an "enhanced" edition of the Dragon Ball Super anime that features a reconstruction of the story, and includes new and redrawn cuts.

The official announcement of the anime stated:

The project features extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. Living up to the name ENHANCED, this edition employs the latest visual expression to deliver greater power and immersion across all scenes, especially the battle sequences. The result is an ENHANCED edition that expresses Akira Toriyama 's original idea and worldbuilding more accurately, that will be broadcasted with highly satisfying quality.

The anime staff stated, "the anime Dragon Ball Super ... is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus in Fall 2026."

The staff describes the story:

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Dragon Ball Super premiered in July 2015 and aired for 131 episodes until March 2018. Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation released the series on home video. Funimation debuted the English dub to its streaming service in December 2016. The English dub premiered on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2017.
author: ANN

title: Yasuaki Mikami's Looks like a Job for a Maid! Light Novels Get TV Anime
content:
Earth Star Novel announced on Thursday that Yasuaki Mikami 's Looks like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid ( Maid Nara Tōzen Desu. Nureginu o Kiserareta Bannō Maid-san wa Tabi ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita ) light novel series is getting a television anime adaptation.

For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence... None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way!

Mikami first published the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2021. Earth Star Entertainment started publishing the novels with illustration by Kinta in July 2022. The ninth volume will ship on October 15.

Ayahito Kumagai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Earth Star Entertainment 's Comic Earth Star manga website in October 2022. The manga's first compiled book volume shipped in April 2023, and the seventh volume shipped on May 13. J-Novel Club is also releasing the manga in English.

title: New Obocchama-kun Anime Airs on TV in Japan in 2027 (Updated)
content:
TV Asahi announced on Thursday that the new Indian-animated Obocchama-kun show based on Yoshinori Kobayashi 's Obocchama-kun manga will air in Japan in 2027 under the title Obocchama-kun Reborn .

The company unveiled a teaser promotional video and visual:

Chie Kōjiro is reprising the role of the protagonist Obocchama-kun from the original 1989 anime.

Sidheswar Shukla directed the show at Green Gold Animation . The series will have 26 episodes (22 minutes each), and will be targeted at children 6-11 years old. In India the series will air on ' Sony YAY!.' The new anime project is being carried out together with Sony Pictures Networks India , Sony Group 's local subsidiary. Under the supervision of Yoshinori Kobayashi , Shinei Animation is producing the scenario.

The new anime will feature stories that were not adapted from the original manga, as well as new stories supervised by series creator Kobayashi.

In an interview with Animation Xpress at the Animation & More Summit in September 2025, business head at SPNI Ambesh Tiwari talked about the how the original Obocchama-kun anime became a huge success in India during the 2020 lockdowns. He noted how it was the efforts of the localization team that made the anime relatable to an Indian audience.

Maiko Sumida from TV Asahi discussed at the Japanese premiere of the anime at the 1st Aichi-Nagoya International Animation Film Festival last December the decision to produce the new series in India, stating that with huge demand from India for a sequel, it would not be ready in time if produced in Japan. So if they produced the scenario in Japan and produced the animation in India they could meet the scheduling demands.

The Obocchama-kun anime's YouTube channel describes the original 1989 series:

The extremely crude Obocchama(Obo Cchama / 'Obocchama-Kun') is the heir of the wealthy Obo family and a new student at the elite Denenchofu Academy. The show is an upper-class comedy anime revolving around Cchama's eccentric elementary school classmates: Kakino Shuhei, the first friend Cchama makes without the help of money; Ojo Samayo, Cchama's fiancee whose family runs the Ojo Company; Fukurokoji Kanemitsu whose family are nearly as rich as the Obos; and the proud Binbo Taijo('Binbocchama') whose family used to be well-off.

The original 164-episode anime adaptation of Kobayashi's Obocchama-kun manga aired in Japan from 1989 to 1992.

Kobayashi's manga serialized in Shogakukan 's CoroCoro Comic magazine from 1986 to 1994. Shogakukan published 24 compiled book volumes of the manga.

Update: Corrected and updated article as the new series is the same as the Japanese-Indian co-production announced in 2024.

In an interview with Animation Xpress at the Animation & More Summit in September 2025, business head at SPNI Ambesh Tiwari talked about the how the original Obocchama-kun anime became a huge success in India during the 2020 lockdowns. He noted how it was the efforts of the localization team that made the anime relatable to an Indian audience.

Maiko Sumida from TV Asahi discussed at the Japanese premiere of the anime at the 1st Aichi-Nagoya International Animation Film Festival last December the decision to produce the new series in India, stating that with huge demand from India for a sequel, it would not be ready in time if produced in Japan. So if they produced the scenario in Japan and produced the animation in India they could meet the scheduling demands.
The Obocchama-kun anime's YouTube channel describes the original 1989 series:

The extremely crude Obocchama(Obo Cchama / 'Obocchama-Kun') is the heir of the wealthy Obo family and a new student at the elite Denenchofu Academy. The show is an upper-class comedy anime revolving around Cchama's eccentric elementary school classmates: Kakino Shuhei, the first friend Cchama makes without the help of money; Ojo Samayo, Cchama's fiancee whose family runs the Ojo Company; Fukurokoji Kanemitsu whose family are nearly as rich as the Obos; and the proud Binbo Taijo('Binbocchama') whose family used to be well-off.
The original 164-episode anime adaptation of Kobayashi's Obocchama-kun manga aired in Japan from 1989 to 1992.
Kobayashi's manga serialized in Shogakukan 's CoroCoro Comic magazine from 1986 to 1994. Shogakukan published 24 compiled book volumes of the manga.
Update: Corrected and updated article as the new series is the same as the Japanese-Indian co-production announced in 2024.

title: Light Novel 'Maid nara Touzen desu. Nureginu wo Kiserareta Bannou Maid-san wa Tabi ni Deru Koto ni shimashita' Gets TV Anime
content:
Publishing company Earth Star Entertainment announced a television anime adaptation of Yasuaki Mikami 's Maid nara Touzen desu. Nureginu wo Kiserareta Bannou Maid-san wa Tabi ni Deru Koto ni shimashita ( Looks Like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid ) light novel on Thursday, revealing an announcement promo.

Mikami began penning the fantasy adventure story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in September 2021. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the light novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in July 2022, featuring illustrations by Kinta . The eighth volume was released in November 2025.

Ayahito Kumagai launched a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth☆Star web service in October 2022. Earth Star Entertainment published the seventh volume on May 13.

J-Novel Club licensed both the manga and light novel for digital release in English in July 2025 and August 2025, respectively. The fifth manga volume went on sale on September 9, with the sixth volume scheduled for a December 2 release. The fourth light novel volume was released on September 28, with the fifth volume going on sale on December 28.

Synopsis For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence... None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way! (Source: J-Novel Club)

Announcement

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms U.S. Release Date & Streaming Platform – Watch Trailer
content:
Dragon Ball Super is coming back to screens this Fall with a new remake anime series, and now it has officially confirmed its release date and streaming home for its United States debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is kicking into gear as fans are about to see a whole new wave of anime making their debut with the start of October. This not only includes some brand new shows, but also plenty of franchises returning for new entries and sequels too. This includes Dragon Ball Super’ s return.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is a new remake of the original TV anime series that enhances the first few arcs, and will be making its debut later this October in Japan. But while it will be premiering on October 11th in that region , it has now been confirmed to be coming to Netflix in the United States on October 17th . To help celebrate the confirmation of its streaming release date, Netflix has dropped a new trailer for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus that you can check out below.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms October 2026 Netflix Release

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be making its debut on October 11th in Japan, and then will be made available for streaming with Netflix in the United States on October 17th. It’s yet to be confirmed as of this time whether or not the anime will also be making its way to other platforms (and what dates that those releases will fall on), but this is still a big move forward either way. Considering this remake is one of the most anticipated new releases of the Fall, getting any news on its streaming release is a pretty big deal.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be directed by Tadayoshi Yamamuro for Toei Animation with Matsuto Seya providing the composition and direction arrangement, Eichi Nishimura serving as editor, Yosuke Motoki serving as compositing director, and Norihito Sumitomo composing the music. This new series will also be getting an updated set of theme songs for its debut too with an opening theme titled “ONOGAMI” as performed by MEGATERA・ZERO, and a new ending theme titled “Kan Peki No Peki” as performed by VK Blanka.

What to Know for Dragon Ball Super’s New Remake

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been touted as an “enhanced” edition of the original TV anime series teased by Toei to feature “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” The series will be going all the way back to the Battle of Gods arc, and will then make its way to the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arc during the course of its run this Fall.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will also be making its way to New York Comic Con 2026 this Fall with a special panel for the new remake series on October 8th. Bulma’s English dub voice actor Monica Rial will be hosting the panel with Jason Douglas (English dub voice of Beerus) and Ian Sinclair (English dub voice of Whis) attending as special guests. Fans can hope to see more updates from it all soon enough.
